sentences.text: In the same scene, Ronald Lacey, who played SD agent Arnold Toht in Raiders of the Lost Ark, cameos as Heinrich Himmler.

Wrestler and stuntman Pat Roach, who played three roles in the previous two films (notably the musclebound German soldier who gets into a fistfight with Jones in Raiders of the Lost Ark), made a short cameo as the Nazi who accompanies Vogel to the Zeppelin.
